quest.title: In Search of a Hidden Heart
quest.description: The guide who has possessed the Secret Source Servant seems intent on guiding visitors to the "Heart of the Sacred Mountain"... However, getting there appears to require a permit, along with the activation of the Secret Source Dragon Idol guarding the entrance. Perhaps the Secret Source Servant can shed more light on the situation...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x350, Primogem x40, Mora x30000, Hero's Wit x4, Mystic Enhancement Ore x4

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Please mark the next site Abyssal corrosion site...

dialogues.speaker: Secret Source Servant
dialogues.text: Affirmative. It has been marked... Please clear the Abyss-corrupted zone as soon as possible to retrieve the data stored there.

dialogues.speaker: Secret Source Servant
dialogues.text: From there, the database may be restored, preserved, and maintained, such that the required content may be accessed.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ah! A Secret Source Servant... Huh. Is it just Paimon, or is this one bigger than the others?

dialogues.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
dialogues.text: Rawr!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hehe, fancy meeting you again so soon!

dialogues.speaker: Secret Source Servant
dialogues.text: ...Apologies, but there are no entries regarding you logged in my database.

dialogues.speaker: Secret Source Servant
dialogues.text: Humans this far down... This has not happened in at least 500 years.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wait, you're not Amaru... or Ehecatl, are you?

dialogues.speaker: Secret Source Servant
dialogues.text: ...There were indeed individuals referred to as such, but I am neither of them.

dialogues.speaker: Secret Source Servant
dialogues.text: I believe there must be some misunderstanding.

dialogues.speaker: Secret Source Servant
dialogues.text: I am a prototype created to assist Lord Xiuhcoatl with information recording, so I have no name.

dialogues.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
dialogues.text: Roar...

dialogues.speaker: Secret Source Servant
dialogues.text: Wait... No... Not that I have no name, I...

dialogues.speaker: Secret Source Servant
dialogues.text: I am the only intelligent Secret Source Servant without a master. Even after Lord Xiuhcoatl fell, I was still in charge of the most basic...

dialogues.speaker: Secret Source Servant
dialogues.text: The most basic city maintenance and information recording functions.

dialogues.speaker: Secret Source Servant
dialogues.text: However, some records have been lost due to the invasion of our shadowy foe, so I do not have data regarding my name.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yeah, seems like we've got the wrong guy... Err, dragon-robot?

dialogues.speaker: Secret Source Servant
dialogues.text: It is fine.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmm. This robot is huge, but it doesn't seem too bright.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #This probably isn't that guy who uses machines to talk to us, {NICKNAME}...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: But it did say that it is in charge of record-keeping and stuff, right?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Why don't we ask it what it knows, then? Or... You know, about how we can reach the Heart of the Sacred Mountain!

dialogues.speaker: Secret Source Servant
dialogues.text: Do you have any queries?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How do we enter the Heart of the Sacred Mountain?

dialogues.speaker: Secret Source Servant
dialogues.text: The entrance to the Heart of the Sacred Mountain is at the newly-excavated entrance... descend into the deepest fissure of the volcano, where it is defended by a Secret Source Dragon Idol.

dialogues.speaker: Secret Source Servant
dialogues.text: Moreover, any who wish to gain access to the Heart must also obtain a "permit"...

dialogues.speaker: Secret Source Servant
dialogues.text: Only then can you gain the acknowledgement of the Secret Source Dragon Idol that stands guard... Heart of the Sacred Mountain, also known as Huitzilopochtli...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Where can we get this permit...

dialogues.speaker: Secret Source Servant
dialogues.text: According to the agreement and the edict issued by Lord Xiuhcoatl, entry to... The Heart of the Sacred Mountain, also known as "Huitzilopochtli"... the descendants of...

dialogues.speaker: Secret Source Servant
dialogues.text: Proceed unto the Chamber of Deliberation to submit an application, and then wait for the permit to be issued.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What about the energy source required by Secret Source Dragon Idols?

dialogues.speaker: Secret Source Servant
dialogues.text: Now, searching... No corresponding data entry categories... Or perhaps the relevant data, like so much else, has become lost due to the Abyssal corruption of the city...

dialogues.speaker: Secret Source Servant
dialogues.text: If you can eliminate the Abyss's influence and retrieve the data, perhaps you might find the entries you seek.

dialogues.speaker: Secret Source Servant
dialogues.text: I have marked out a potential data storage location for you. Please eliminate the Abyssal corruption present there to restore the area.

dialogues.speaker: Secret Source Servant
dialogues.text: Do you have any queries?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I have no more questions...

dialogues.speaker: Secret Source Servant
dialogues.text: Understood.

dialogues.speaker: Secret Source Servant
dialogues.text: Greetings. New data recovery category detected.

dialogues.speaker: Secret Source Servant
dialogues.text: ...Entries concerning Source Mechanism energy cores have been updated.

dialogues.speaker: Secret Source Servant
dialogues.text: Phlogiston is the main form of energy that powers Source Mechanisms, albeit in a condensed form that closely resembles light.

dialogues.speaker: Secret Source Servant
dialogues.text: Stable amounts of Phlogiston Units may be generated via the controlled reaction known as [DATA LOST] allowing for more precise control over energy release.

dialogues.speaker: Secret Source Servant
dialogues.text: The energy that a Source Mechanism requires is dependent on both size and the complexity of its operating logic. The quantity of Phlogiston Units a Secret Source Servant requires is [DATA LOST]...

dialogues.speaker: Secret Source Servant
dialogues.text: While the larger Secret Source Dragon Idols, in fact, require less — specifically, three in number.

dialogues.speaker: Secret Source Servant
dialogues.text: "Information is energy, and energy is information." The data carrier you retrieved counts as a single Phlogiston Unit...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: So one "Phlogiston Unit" is one fireball...

dialogues.speaker: Secret Source Servant
dialogues.text: Yes, that is one way to look at it. You restored a Phlogiston Unit that had been corrupted by the Abyss. Only then could I extract anything from it...

dialogues.speaker: Secret Source Servant
dialogues.text: They can also be used as substitute energy sources for Abyss-corroded Source Mechanisms.

talks.objective: Continue on your path to the Heart of the Sacred Mountain

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Show me the records concerning "Corrosion and Physical Conditions"...

dialogues.speaker: Secret Source Servant
dialogues.text: Of course. Now reading, please wait.

dialogues.speaker: Secret Source Servant
dialogues.text: Record playback complete.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Show me the entries for "Humans... and Exceptional Individuals Thereof"

dialogues.speaker: Secret Source Servant
dialogues.text: Of course. Now reading, please wait.

dialogues.speaker: Secret Source Servant
dialogues.text: Record playback complete.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How do we enter the Heart of the Sacred Mountain?

dialogues.speaker: Secret Source Servant
dialogues.text: The entrance to the Heart is close by. When recreating Tollan's city center, Lord Xiuhcoatl excavated downward in order to create a stable experimental environment...

dialogues.speaker: Secret Source Servant
dialogues.text: And there, he built the ultimate weapon for use against the Abyss.

dialogues.speaker: Secret Source Servant
dialogues.text: However, the seal has caused this device to suffer from the deepest Abyss corrosion. Thus was the city taken over...

dialogues.speaker: Secret Source Servant
dialogues.text: The entrance to the Sacred Mountain's heart lies beneath the fissures in the Sacred City... That is also where our shadowy foe's corruption runs the deepest.

dialogues.speaker: Secret Source Servant
dialogues.text: Do you have any other inquiries? Or do you wish to mark out the next location where retrievable data might be stored?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Let's access the data we've recovered...

dialogues.speaker: Secret Source Servant
dialogues.text: Reading corresponding content... What records do you need to access?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I don't have further questions...

dialogues.speaker: Secret Source Servant
dialogues.text: Understood.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Read me the entries marked "Creating the Secret Source Servants..."

dialogues.speaker: Secret Source Servant
dialogues.text: Of course. Now reading, please wait.

dialogues.speaker: Secret Source Servant
dialogues.text: Record playback complete.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Where can we get this permit...

dialogues.speaker: Secret Source Servant
dialogues.text: According to the agreement and the edict issued by Lord Xiuhcoatl, entry to... The Heart of the Sacred Mountain, also known as "Huitzilopochtli"... the descendants of...

dialogues.speaker: Secret Source Servant
dialogues.text: Proceed unto the Chamber of Deliberation to submit an application, and then wait for the permit to be issued.

dialogues.speaker: Secret Source Servant
dialogues.text: If you wish to go there, I shall mark its location for you.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: It's fine. There isn't anything I'd like to read right now.

dialogues.speaker: Secret Source Servant
dialogues.text: Understood.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Let's access the data we've recovered...

dialogues.speaker: Secret Source Servant
dialogues.text: Apologies, but I do not have any restored data at present...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How do we enter the Heart of the Sacred Mountain?

dialogues.speaker: Secret Source Servant
dialogues.text: The entrance to the Heart of the Sacred Mountain is at the newly-excavated entrance... descend into the deepest fissure of the volcano, where it is defended by a Secret Source Dragon Idol.

dialogues.speaker: Secret Source Servant
dialogues.text: Moreover, any who wish to gain access to the Heart must also obtain a "permit," and for safety reasons...

dialogues.speaker: Secret Source Servant
dialogues.text: Only then can you gain the acknowledgement of the Secret Source Dragon Idol that stands guard... Heart of the Sacred Mountain, also known as Huitzilopochtli...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ah, right, Amaru did say earlier that the guardian dragon statue needs power...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: "Specifically, three in number," they said. That means we need three "small fireballs" in total, right?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmm... Paimon doesn't quite understand why, but if we want to go to the Heart of the Sacred Mountain, then we need to get a permit and clear out the Abyss...

dialogues.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
dialogues.text: Roawr...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Alright! Let's get going!
